original_root_cause: Split authority between job assignment email (contractor_job_tokens + /job?token=) and portal invite (password_tokens, /contractor-set-password). Landlord assign sent job email without updating portal/onboarding state; job link required active contractor; admin showed Not invited when only job email was sent.

post_deploy_regressions_found.summary: update_contractor referenced job_invite_sent_at / job_invite_last_work_order_id in body without function parameters, causing NameError on every contractor update and TypeError on record_contractor_job_invite_sent.
post_deploy_regressions_found.impact: job_invite_sent_at never persisted; portal invite/resend/request-portal-activation returned 500; admin onboarding labels missing from API.

post_deploy_regressions_found.impact: admin onboarding_state / onboarding_state_label null in API responses.
